confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors rest on crowdsourced cost-of-living sites and travel blogs, several of them dated 2021 to 2023, so they are rough. The wine-by-glass anchor is inferred from local bottle prices and the beer anchor because no sourced glass price was found. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and were not checked against live listings. The FX value was taken from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Treated as a US-dollar-pegged Caribbean tourist city with import-driven food costs. Drink and hotel anchors reflect tourist-area pricing, and meal anchors reflect mid-range restaurants with tourist-area uplift.
